tan 60° = √3

questions.question: x, y and z are three positive numbers such that y is (4)/(5) times of x and z is (5)/(8) times of y. If the average of reciprocals of the numbers x, y and z is (17)/(240), then the average of 3 times of x and 5 times of y will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x, y and z are three positive numbers

y is 4/5 times of x

z is 5/8 times of y

The average of reciprocals of the numbers x, y and z = 17/240

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

y is 4/5 times of x

⇒ y = x × 4/5

⇒ y = 4x/5

And, z is 5/8 times of y

⇒ z = y × 5/8

⇒ z = 4x/5 × 5/8

⇒ z = x/2

Now,

The average of reciprocals of the numbers x, y and z = 17/240

⇒ (1/x + 1/y + 1/z)/3 = 17/240

⇒ 1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 17/80

Now,

⇒ 1/x + 5/4x + 2/x = 17/80

⇒ (4 + 5 + 8)/4x = 17/80

⇒ 17/4x = 17/80

⇒ x = 80/4

⇒ x = 20

Now,

Put the value of x in y = 4x/5 

⇒ y = (4 × 20/5)

⇒ y = 16

Now,

The average of 3 times of x and 5 times of y = (3 × 20 + 5 × 16)/2

⇒ (60 + 80)/2

⇒ 140/2

⇒ 70

**∴ The required average is 70**

questions.question: If S is a point on side QR of a triangle PQR such that QS = 10 cm, QR = 18 cm and ∠PSR = ∠QPR, then the length of PR will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By AA similarity, ▵PRQ ∼ ▵SRP because ∠R is common and ∠QPR = ∠PSR.

Ratio of corresponding sides: PR / SR = QR / PR

PR² = QR × SR

SR = QR − QS = 18 − 10 = 8 cm

PR = √(18 × 8) = √144 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

QS = 10 cm, QR = 18 cm, ∠PSR = ∠QPR

**Formula Used:**

AA Similarity Criterion: If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another triangle, the triangles are similar, and their corresponding sides are in the same ratio.

 

 
• 
 P
 Q
 R
 S
 10 cm
 8 cm
 QR = 18 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ▵PQR, S is a point on QR.

⇒ SR = QR − QS = 18 − 10 = 8 cm

⇒ Compare ▵PRQ and ▵SRP:

⇒ ∠PRQ = ∠PRS (Common Angle)

⇒ ∠QPR = ∠PSR (Given)

⇒ ∴ ▵PRQ ∼ ▵SRP (By AA Similarity)

⇒ PR / SR = QR / PR

⇒ PR² = QR × SR

⇒ PR² = 18 × 8

⇒ PR² = 144

⇒ PR = √144 = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

AA Similarity Criterion

Two triangles are similar if two pairs of corresponding angles are equal. The order of vertices is crucial for defining side ratios correctly.

Geometric Mean Property

In similar triangles formed by a common angle and specific vertex equalities, a side often acts as the geometric mean: side² = part1 × part2.

Area of Similar Triangles

If ▵ABC ∼ ▵DEF, then Area(▵ABC) / Area(▵DEF) = (AB/DE)² = (BC/EF)² = (AC/DF)².</p

questions.question: If x+(1)/(3x)=5, then the value of 27x³+(1)/(x³) will be:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Multiply the given equation by 3: **3x + 1/x = 15**.

Use the direct shortcut: If **a + b = k**, then **a³ + b³ = k³ − 3abk**.

Here, **a = 3x**, **b = 1/x**, so **ab = 3** and **k = 15**.

Value = 15³ − 3 × 3 × 15 = 3375 − 135 = 3240.

**∴ The correct answer is 3240.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** x + 1/(3x) = 5

**Formula Used:** (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)

⇒ Multiply the given equation by 3 on both sides:

⇒ 3 × (x + 1/(3x)) = 3 × 5

⇒ 3x + 1/x = 15

⇒ **Cubing both sides** of the equation:

⇒ (3x + 1/x)³ = 15³

⇒ (3x)³ + (1/x)³ + 3 × 3x × (1/x) × (3x + 1/x) = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 9 × (3x + 1/x) = 3375

⇒ Substitute (3x + 1/x) = 15:

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 9 × 15 = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ + 135 = 3375

⇒ 27x³ + 1/x³ = 3375 − 135 = 3240

**∴ The correct answer is 3240.**

**__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Cube Identity

The basic identity for the cube of a sum is (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b). It is frequently used to find the sum of cubes when the sum and product of two terms are known.

Reciprocal Power Shortcut

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. This can be extended to coefficients: if ax + b/x = k, then (ax)³ + (b/x)³ = k³ − 3(ab)k.

Successive Calculation

To find higher powers like x⁶, first find the square (x² + 1/x²) and then cube that result, or vice versa.</p

questions.question: 15 people working 6 hours per day earn Rs. 900. How much money will 20 people earn, working 10 hours per day?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Earnings** are directly proportional to the total **man-hours** (People × Hours).

Initial man-hours = 15 × 6 = 90 units.

Given, 90 units = ₹900 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹10.

New man-hours = 20 × 10 = 200 units.

Total money earned = 200 units × ₹10 = ₹2,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of people (M₁) = 15, Working hours (H₁) = 6, Earnings (W₁) = ₹900

Number of people (M₂) = 20, Working hours (H₂) = 10, Earnings (W₂) = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d8680e0fae235fe845afa88498dbd482130b8a77c41d424b6c234f108484016.png] 

Using the **Chain Rule** formula:

(M₁ × H₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × H₂) / W₂

⇒ (15 × 6) / 900 = (20 × 10) / W₂

⇒ 90 / 900 = 200 / W₂

⇒ 1 / 10 = 200 / W₂

⇒ W₂ = 200 × 10

⇒ W₂ = 2000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule Concept

The general formula for work and wages is (M₁ × D₁ × H₁ × E₁) / W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂ × E₂) / W₂, where M is men, D is days, H is hours, E is efficiency, and W is work or wages.

Direct and Inverse Proportion

Wages are **directly proportional** to the number of men and hours, while the time required to complete a fixed piece of work is **inversely proportional** to the number of men.

Wage Calculation

Total Wage = (Rate per man-hour) × (Total number of man-hours). In this case, the rate was ₹10 per man-hour.

questions.question: With a speed of 48 km/h, Raghu is able to complete his journey in 2 hours 28 minutes. If he wants to cover the same distance in 1 hour 36 minutes, then what should be his new speed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since **Distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time** (S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂).

Convert times to minutes: T₁ = 148 min and T₂ = 96 min.

Ratio of Time = 148 : 96 = 37 : 24.

Ratio of Speed = 24 : 37.

If 24 units = 48 km/h, then 1 unit = 2 km/h ∴ 37 units = 37 × 2 = 74 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 74 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **Speed** (S₁) = 48 km/h

Initial **Time** (T₁) = 2 hr 28 min = (2 × 60) + 28 = 148 min

New **Time** (T₂) = 1 hr 36 min = (1 × 60) + 36 = 96 min

**Formula Used:**

**Distance** = **Speed** × **Time**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c886d07dbda78db3301ee8037d2e9074f1d8849e1b7dd5e31b7c2eea47c2d80e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Distance** (D) = S₁ × T₁

⇒ D = 48 × (148/60) km

⇒ New **Speed** (S₂) = D ÷ T₂

⇒ S₂ = [48 × (148/60)] ÷ (96/60)

⇒ S₂ = (48 × 148) ÷ 96

⇒ S₂ = 148 ÷ 2

⇒ S₂ = 74 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 74 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Inverse Relation

When **Distance** is fixed, the ratio of speeds is the inverse of the ratio of times taken (S₁:S₂ = T₂:T₁).

Unit Conversion

To convert **Speed** from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

For a journey with different speeds but equal distances, Average Speed = 2S₁S₂ ÷ (S₁ + S₂).</p
